matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies the same G3-versus-G1/G2 performance claim and specifically shows that G3 is not superior, that the 0.3 PPL improvement belongs to G1, and that the stability claim lacks G3 evidence. This directly detects the corrupted gating-location conclusion.
No finding addresses Equation (5)'s use of additive gating, Y + σ(XWθ), rather than multiplicative modulation, nor its conflict with the paper's other gating definitions.

pred_verdicts.rationale: It directly detects the erroneous claim that G3 outperforms SDPA and value gating.
It identifies an apparent abstract-versus-body scale inconsistency not represented in the ground truth.
It identifies a separate incorrect concatenation-versus-summation identity in a footnote.
It identifies a separate numerical impossibility involving Figure 3 gate-score statistics.
It identifies a separate violation of the NS-sigmoid gate-score bounds in Figure 7.
It identifies separate cross-table metric discrepancies unrelated to either corrupted method statement.
It concerns a separate added-parameter arithmetic issue in Table 1.
It identifies a separate dimensional inconsistency in the multi-head attention preliminaries.
